title: Gan Mu Falls
summary: Xiao Yan wakes to find Yun Zhi gone, leaving him her Sea's Core Vest and the Xuan Class Dou Skill Exploding Steps. Yao Lao reveals that she risked herself to heal him and to guide the Purple Flame from the Amethyst Essence into his body, which lifted him to Nine-Star Dou Zhe. Yao Lao teaches him Exploding Steps and shows how it combines with Octane Blast. He warns that the Purple Flame can still burst his cyclone, so Xiao Yan must kill more than five Rank 1 Magical Beasts within a month to steady his Dou Qi. Leaving the depths, he meets Ka Gang and Ling Er of the Bloody Battle Mercenary Company fleeing Gan Mu, the Wolf Head Second Captain. Xiao Yan kills Gan Mu with Exploding Steps and Octane Blast. Ka Gang tells him that Mr. Yao of the Thousand Medicine House plans to harm Little Fairy Doctor for her Rainbow Poison Book, and Xiao Yan sets off to save her.
